reuse.intent: Validate the design-token JSON envelope consumed by the gate.
reuse.public_contract: Missing file skips; warn phase reports findings without enforcing; enforce phase rejects invalid token metadata.
reuse.stability_evidence: Existing Bash and PowerShell twins consume the same schema token and metadata keys.
reuse.consumer_requirements: Bash uses the existing quality-loop jq dependency; PowerShell uses native ConvertFrom-Json.
reuse.divergence_counterexample: ConvertFrom-Json can unroll singleton top-level arrays; jq -s preserves document count and envelope type.
reuse.decision: Reuse existing JSON parsers with explicit per-runtime envelope validation; do not create a shared subprocess parser.
reuse.reason: Parser APIs differ while the public gate contract remains paired; a new parser infrastructure adds no stable capability.
reuse.verification: Paired valid formatted JSON, nested decoy, malformed JSON, multiple documents and root array controls; missing-jq explicit failure.
